caption: a few small changes for the apps you open without thinking. save one to try tonight.

sources.claim: Earnit feature mechanics; no customer outcome claims. Current brief overrides older hidden-feature references.

copy.title: 5 things to try when you keep opening tiktok
1. make your phone boring
copy.body: try grayscale. see if the feed still feels worth opening.

copy.title: 2. mute the invitations
copy.body: turn off notifications from the apps you open without thinking.

copy.title: 3. move the charger
copy.body: charge outside your bedroom. give your thumb a longer commute.

copy.title: 5. choose the next thing first
copy.body: put your shoes by the door before picking up your phone. save this.
